notes: This contract records a portable C++ TCK check that GetRangeBounds and SetRangeBounds reject a DimensionHandle absent from a valid one-dimension region with RegionDoesNotContainSpecifiedDimension. The tested boundary maps to clause 9.1.2 through the Requirements Lab region-lifecycle mapping. Assertions cover only the official API exception type; they do not inspect diagnostics, MOM failure payloads, or provider state. The source uses only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador APIs and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM and configured dimension, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration. No region-based publication, subscription, or routing is asserted.
